page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc9i.24xlarge is a high clock speed, compute-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor and x86_64 architecture. It provides 96 dedicated vCPUs backed by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at 3.4 GHz, paired with 192.0 GB of system RAM. This configuration maintains a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio (2.0 GB per core), focusing resources on compute density rather than large in-memory caches. The server features no discrete GPU hardware.

Storage and networking configurations emphasize network-attached design. The instance does not include bundled local storage, requiring attached network block storage for system images and working data. Networking capabilities include a 48 Gbps baseline network bandwidth for high-throughput host communications, while allocating zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The compute-heavy hardware profile offers strong processing efficiency for applications bounded by CPU frequency rather than memory capacity. Tradeoffs include the absence of onboard NVMe storage and limited per-core RAM, which shifts storage I/O over the network. Appropriate workloads include continuous integration pipelines, batch processing, distributed compute jobs, scientific simulations, and large-scale software compilation.

The server is well suited for CPU-bound tasks such as automated build systems, distributed data processing, mathematical modeling, and compilation clusters.
